counting_unit: Three logical MAIN_RIV inventory groups; not three uniformly named channels or scalar-name approvals.

records.supported_name_scope: The complete selected path runs southeast from a far-northwestern headwater, turns south through the middle corridor, then bends east and southeast into the Gippsland Lakes coastal complex. Direct blue Mitchell river-line labels support Mitchell River in Victoria as a representative system identity. The long northwestern upper continuation is not individually named by the inspected maps; a modeled mainstem can include differently named feeder reaches and does not make every part Mitchell. Exact feeder-to-river name transitions, any river/storage interfaces and the final generalized line through lake or coastal water remain unassigned at reach level.
limits: The blue Mitchell river-line label is direct naming evidence. The black Mitchell-Thomson River basin callout is context only and does not combine or rename these separately selected systems.
No upper tributary name is inferred from the far-northwestern continuation; no exact rendered-part naming partition is assigned.
The original publication is a coarse regional assessment, not a formal naming-register decision or surveyed contemporary mouth map.
Original HydroRIVERS source-coordinate equality and exact source reach-to-rendered-part name mapping are not verified.
No name is extended across generalized lake, estuarine, storage or coastal portions merely because they share a modeled group.
